traditions.description_en: The backbone of Somali society, focused on livestock rearing and seasonal migration in search of pasture.
traditions.description_so: Nidaamka nolosha miyiga waa lafdhabarta bulshada Soomaaliyeed, isagoo ku qotoma dhaqashada xoolaha iyo guur-guurka xilliyeed si loo helo daaq iyo biyo.

traditions.description_en: Somalia is globally renowned as the 'Nation of Poets', where history, wisdom, and laws are preserved and passed down through verse.
traditions.description_so: Soomaaliya waxaa caalamka looga yaqaannaa 'Millaad-ka Gabayaaga', halkaas oo taariikhda, xikmadda, iyo shuruucda bulshada lagu kaydiyo laguna gudbiyo maansooyinka.

food.description_en: The flagship Somali rice dish slow-cooked with aromatic spices, raisins, and served with meat.
food.description_so: Cuntada ugu caansan Soomaalida ee bariiska ah oo lagu kariyey xawaashyo udug badan, sabiib, laguna daray hilib la kariyey.
food.recipe_en: Basmati rice, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, cumin, and lamb or goat meat.
food.recipe_so: Bariis Basmati ah, hayl, qaranfoul, qorfe, kamoon, iyo hilib ari ama hilib geel.

food.description_en: Spiced hot milk tea brewed with ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon, reflecting Somali hospitality.
food.description_so: Shaah kulul oo caano leh laguna kariyey sinjibiil, hayl, iyo qorfe, kaas oo ka turjumaya marti-gelinta Soomaalida.
food.recipe_en: Black tea leaves, milk, ginger, cloves, and fresh cardamom.
food.recipe_so: Caleen shaah ah, caano, sinjibiil, qaranfoul, iyo hayl cusub.
